Title: Shallow Sea
Desc: An interactive tropical shore seen from above: waves wash up the beach, the water deepens from clear shallows to blue, and fish, rays, turtles, dolphins, reef sharks and jellyfish swim by, with clownfish in their anemones and an octopus that changes colour to hide. Swipe for ripples, click to splash, drag on the sand to write. 可以互動的熱帶海岸。
Author: Lego514
